definitions.explanation: Things of various sizes; the contrast between big and small.
The dimension or magnitude of something.

examples.japanese: {大小|だいしょう}さまざまな{石|いし}が{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: Stones of various sizes are lined up.

examples.japanese: {大小|だいしょう}の{差|さ}に{関係|かんけい}なく{平等|びょうどう}に{扱|あつか}う。
examples.english: To treat equally regardless of size.

examples.japanese: {大小|だいしょう}2つの{箱|はこ}を{用意|ようい}した。
examples.english: I prepared two boxes, one large and one small.

notes:
{大小|だいしょう} combines {大|だい} (large) and {小|しょう} (small) to express contrast in size or various sizes.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大小|だいしょう}さまざま: of various sizes
- {大小|だいしょう}の{差|さ}: difference in size
